meta.title: The Big Beetle Poster
meta.textType: a poster with facts and numbers

paragraphs: On Thursday, Mia made a fact poster in the school library. It was about a big beetle from the nature park. Ranger Mark gave the club a paper with all the numbers. Mia loves animals, and she wanted a poster with only facts. Leo drew a big beetle in the middle, and Lily helped with the words. Teacher Kim put the poster on the library wall. Many children stopped to look at it before the club began.

This is the first part of the poster. "THE RHINOCEROS BEETLE" "Length: six centimeters." "Weight: twelve grams." "This creature has one long horn on its head." "It is very strong, and it can carry things that are heavy." "A beetle that is six centimeters long is not small." "How heavy is it? It is not as heavy as a small apple."

Leo looked at the numbers and asked a question. "Is twelve grams a lot?" he asked. "No, it is not," said Mia. "A small apple is about one hundred grams." "So the beetle is not as heavy as an apple, and it is much smaller." Lily wrote this on the poster, too. "The beetle has two pairs of wings." "The hard wings cover the soft wings, and the soft wings are for flying."

This is the second part of the poster. "Life: The beetle lives for about one year." "Most of that time, it lives under the ground." "It likes warm weather, from twenty-five to thirty degrees." "At night, it comes out of the ground to look for food." "Every day is a small adventure for a beetle." "Can you find a beetle in your garden?" Mia smiled when she read the last line. She liked to find an animal that was small but very strong.

The club read the poster after lunch. "The beetle is six centimeters long, and it lives for one year," said Lily. "It likes twenty-five to thirty degrees," said Leo. "Today is thirty-one degrees, so it is too hot for the beetle." "The beetle stays under the ground," said Mia. "That is why you do not see it in the day." Teacher Kim said, "Your poster is very clear," and Mia was very happy. She wrote her name at the bottom: "Poster by Mia."
